name: COLD OPEN
tagline: A routine sweep of a facility that should be empty.

briefing.speaker: VECTOR
briefing.text: Blacksite Zero. Decommissioned nine months ago, power still drawn on the main bus. Walk it, confirm it is empty, come home.

briefing.speaker: OPERATIVE
briefing.text: Empty facilities do not draw power.

debrief.speaker: VECTOR
debrief.text: Contact volume was not consistent with a decommissioned site.

debrief.speaker: ARCHIVIST
debrief.text: It is consistent with a staffed one. Someone filed the closure and nobody left.

document.name: INTAKE VARIANCE
document.body: Facility closure was filed on schedule and countersigned. Personnel egress records for the same period list four departures against a standing complement of sixty-one. The remaining fifty-seven have continued to draw hazard pay at a site that does not, on paper, exist.
